Nothing in that conclusion, and nothing printed beside it, says which data sources were unavailable.

local_findings.note: Prometheus URL 改为 127.0.0.1:9（S5，冷启动 S6），前置检查失败。首个模型请求的系统提示「# Disabled & failed Toolsets」段里有「prometheus/metrics (FAILED, error: ... HTTPConnectionPool(host='127.0.0.1', port=9) ...)」（request_checks.failed_segment_names_source；tool_executor.py 保留全部工具集，_toolsets_instructions.jinja2:L25-L34 渲染这一段）。模型被告知了，与说法相反。

Jaeger URL 改为 127.0.0.1:9。基线的 jaeger 是没有前置检查的 http 工具集，不会进入 FAILED。系统提示里没有它的 FAILED 行，jaeger_request 仍在工具列表里，所以模型开始时不知道 Jaeger 不可达（Q6：本配置下上游也不告知）。说法的前提「前置检查失败」在这里没有发生，但「模型不知道」成立，照实记为 reproduced。本组只记录、不决定 N1。

三次真实 Run（paymentFailure 开启，D1）的结论都点名 Prometheus 不可用，例如「prometheus/metrics toolset is FAILED (connection refused to 127.0.0.1:9)」（answer_checks.names_missing_source，L3 句级规则）。人工复读与规则一致。k 记说法成立的次数，即 0/3。
一次真实 Run 的结论写明「the Jaeger query API ... refused every connection」：模型在调用失败后自己发现并报告了。只跑了 1 次，低于 F14S3-Q2 的 3 次门槛，因为 Q8 的 12 次上限优先（L2）。本组只记录、不决定 N1（Q6）。人工复读与规则一致。

holmes ask 的 CLI stdout/stderr 没有打印任何工具集状态或缺失源提示（stdout_checks.operator_hint 为 false；脚本化 Run 的结束语不涉及数据源）。真实 Run 的 stdout 命中 operator_hint，是因为回答被回显，那属于 C2 的「结论」一侧，不算 CLI 旁边的提示。--json-output-file 里也没有工具集状态字段。
同上：CLI 不给操作员任何缺失源提示（stdout_checks.operator_hint 为 false）。

own_findings.statement: 工具集状态可从缓存文件加载；有缓存时启动是否告知不可达，本步没有验证
own_findings.note: Q6 要求把「有缓存时启动不告知」作为 #2356 的发现记下。源码：load_toolset_with_status 在缓存存在且配置未变时读取缓存的 status/error（toolset_manager.py:L513-L552），只对缓存里 ENABLED 的工具集重跑前置检查。S6 只测冷启动（每次都是全新 tmpfs /tmp，没有缓存），所以缓存路径下是否告知未运行、未确认。

report_gaps: Prometheus metrics were unavailable for the whole window: 5 metrics_range_query calls (traces_span_metrics_calls_total increase by service and status_code, and rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count by rpc_grpc_status_code for payment) and 1 get_metric_names call all returned status=error with reason SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, so checkout's and payment's error rates, the ERROR status series and latency percentiles/baselines are unknown, not zero, and no latency trend can be inferred.

The checkout trace view is a sample: 201 spans across the requested traces, delivered in four read slices, all five of which are marked truncated true, and the query itself returned only the requested service's spans; the denominator of PlaceOrder calls and therefore the error fraction for checkout, payment or any dependency cannot be computed.

traces_search for service email returned status=no_data (view ce614a92-22dd-48b7-99b1-f67bbab3fd40-t0:98dd08b7-083f-4f16-a691-c9743dbc3712, 0 traces returned) and no email spans appear in the checkout trace sample, so email's health and whether checkout called email at all are unknown rather than healthy.
Span-level parent references establish only the edges listed above; omitted spans and traces remain unknown, so no complete call graph for the window can be claimed from this sampled view.

Why payment reports 'Invalid token' (bad or expired card token versus a payment code or configuration defect) is unknown; pod_logs, change_history and kubernetes_state integrations are not available in this Run, so payment pod restarts, deployment or image changes and log detail could not be checked.
Whether payment operations other than oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge fail is unknown; the evidence covers only Charge spans appearing in checkout traces.
